CodBi_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_PLZ.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a postal code in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set. Must be grouped with related address fields (Locality, Street, BuildingNumber).

CodBi_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_Locality.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a locality/city in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set.

CodBi_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_Street.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a street in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set.

CodBi_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_BuildingNumber.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a building number in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set.
